case.title: Work order number, unit number and status cannot be turned off on cards
case.custom_preconds:
Dev-layer test — fe-unit. Existing coverage: boardFields.spec.ts:69,223; WorkOrderBoardCard.spec.ts:467

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • One technician at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Always On" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location. The asset has Unit "TRK-118" (example).
  • One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1], led by [Tech-A].
  • Names and numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Always On" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Always On" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for one work order only; record its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702") (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  5. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page and choose [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.)
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Always On — [WO-1] shows with unit TRK-118, status Approved and Lead Technician [Tech-A]. If not, fix it before starting.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Always On in Search.
  3. Open the Fields to display menu in the toolbar and read the list of fields. Look for Work order number, Unit number and Status.
  4. Turn off every field in the list that can be turned off.
  5. Close the menu and read the [WO-1] card.
  6. Open Fields to display again, turn the fields back on as they were, and close it.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • There is no way to turn off Work order number, Unit number or Status. Either they are not in the Fields to display list at all, or they are listed as always on and cannot be unticked. Both are correct (QA lead's ruling below).
  • With every other field turned off, the card still shows the work order number (e.g. "S1-702"), the unit (e.g. "TRK-118") and the status (e.g. "Approved").

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R3, read 8 Oct 2026. S3-R4 (cards include the mandatory fields). Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 12 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat. Question put to him: “Blocked test 3: number, unit and status can never be turned off and always show on the card, which meets the requirement, but they aren't listed in the menu as 'always on'. What should it say?” His answer, word for word: “Passed (Recommended)”. This test was changed on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d) so that leaving the three out of the menu also passes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R3: “Work order number, unit number when present, and status are mandatory and cannot be deselected.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/12/2026.

changes.new_value:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
